text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...It's... so far away...
I failed... to reach it again...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: Even if it's far, let's walk there together, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, that was it, wasn't it.
I'm not alone."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose to anyone anymore.
I will never... give up."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer found me and believed in me.
I know... I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! No matter how far away it is,
someday, without fail...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I still... have it. Right here in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I...
I haven't given up yet!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I want to stand... right in the center of the stage.
That desire has always...!"
choice_data_list: ...That flame is the beacon that will guide you
...That flame is the beacon that will guide you

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then... I will keep burning.
Until I reach the me I want to become...!
